cargo_verdict: pass — gap spec written in the house format (status/origin/what-exists/what-needs-building/acceptance/non-goals/open-questions), every machinery claim probed live before being written, codex-validated and patched
process_verdict: pass — slice selected by ratified order + operator nod; operator pins carried verbatim into the spec; scope fence held (no build, no new surface); intake handled through the lane without preempting
exit_state: spec awaits ONE ratification nod (open questions carry defaults — silence ratifies defaults). On ratification: act-two backlog entry converts to a build_slice with the spec as spec_ref; AUDIT/PLAN selects it.
